strings.footer.desc: Ukwazi Lomhlaba, Umfuzo & Ukuvuseleliso Kwe-Digital — TQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah. Isixhobo esinye, imisebenzi emininzi.
strings.footer.everyStatement: Into yonke ibandayo ibonakalisa iqinisekiso layo.
strings.home.kicker: TQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah · Ukwazi · Umfuzo · Ukuvuseleliso
strings.home.subtitle: Platform yeGlobal yeKnowledge, yeHeritage & yeDigital Preservation yeTQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah
strings.home.lede: 165 akakho iwebhsa yonke. Iyi-nkqubo ye-digital — i-platform yekwazi, i-archive, isiseko sokulinganisa, idirectory, i-graph yekwazi, kunye ne-nqanaba lokubonisana — esekwe ukuba into yonke ibandayo ingatshatyalaliselwe kwiqinisekiso layo.
strings.home.identityLede: 165 yasekwe ngokuchanekileyo njengokungena kwamafuncsi amanee e-10 ezenza inkqubo, eza kuhlala kwi-data esisiseko esinye.
strings.home.principleLede: Idatha elungileyo lilungisa iprofayili, ukuhlola, umshini, isikhashana, igraph, i-archive, ukulinganisa, ukubonisana, i-AI, i-API, kunye nezemfundo zamasontsi. Akukho ukudibanisa. Akukho ukulahlekela.
strings.home.docsTitle: Iidokumenti ezili-6 ze-165 zokulawula — Master Control, Ukulawula, IConstitution yaseEditorial, IPolicy yesiSource — kungabhalisiwe ngokupheleleyo.
strings.home.docsSub: Iicopy ezi-verbatim · v1.0 · ukuhlola kwedokumenti · uluhlu lwesiqhingi esishushu
strings.home.depositBody: Iidokumenti ezili-6 ze-control ezikanonicali (Master Control 000, Ukulawula 007, IConstitution yaseEditorial 008, IPolicy yesiSource & yokuBonisana 009, Master Blueprint, I-Architecture yesiSystem) zidiloliswe kunye zibhalwe ngokupheleleyo kwii-Roid zeedokumenti. ICharter yomsebenzi wokuqala kunye needokumenti ezingezekileyo ezidingekayo zikho zazingathathwa — le nto ishona kwaze kwedlula idokumenti edityaniswe ngokupheleleyo.
strings.sec.explore.title: Into yonke, umshini wokwazi
strings.sec.explore.lede: Vula abantu, iinkqubo, indawo, imisebenzi, amagama, amaxwebhu, kunye neempazamo. Umphetho walo wonke unokulingana kweqinisekiso kunye nenkqubo yokuqinisekisa.
strings.sec.library.title: Iincwadi, amagqirha & iicollections
strings.sec.library.lede: I-Library ishicilela iincwadi kunye nee-collections nge-metadata engqongqwe kwi-citation: ukubhala, ukulingana, iinkqubo ezisebenzisayo, kunye neemaxwebhu. Akukho into ishicilelayo ngaphandle kwerikodi.
strings.sec.archive.title: Iidokumenti, isiko lokubhala & iirekhodi lemfuzo
strings.sec.archive.lede: I-Archive idla ngokuchanekileko ngokuba idokumenti ze-digital njengomfuzo: zivunyelwe, zicwangciswe, kwaye zikwazi ukutyibilika. Iirekhoid zesiko zingaguquki — ukunciphisa kudla, akukho ukudla.
strings.sec.research.title: Imaxwebhu, impazamo & ibibliography
strings.sec.research.lede: Iqela lokulinganisa lihlanisa into eseyiyo kusuka kwindlela egqibayo. Impazamo ibandayo ngokungena kwayo; imaxwebhu ibandayo ngokulingana kwayo; akukho into igqiba iqinisekiso layo.
strings.sec.academy.title: Ukwazi okusekelwe kumaxwebhu, akukwi-authority
strings.sec.academy.lede: I-Academy izakuhlolisa iicourses, iicurriculum, kunye neefellowship — into yonke eyifuna iirekhodi efuna kuwo. Isiseko sayo sisekwe apha: inqanaba leterminology ishona.
strings.sec.media.title: Video, umculo, idokumenti & ukubonisa
strings.sec.media.lede: Iiregistri yemedia izakudokumentisa iindawo, iintlangano, kunye neefootage yemfuzo — into nganye ilungiselelwa kwindawo edokumentisayo, akukho into ibetha ngokupheleleyo.
strings.sec.trust.title: Ukuba 165 ukwazi — isiseko sokuvumeleka
strings.sec.trust.lede: 165 ayifuna ukuvumeleka ngokungena kwi-authority. Ifuna ukutshabalaliswa. Into yonke ibandayo unokulingana kweqinisekiso, inkqubo yokuqinisekisa, imaxwebhu, kunye nekhumbulo layo eliqhelekileyo.
strings.sec.about.title: Inkqubo, yasekwa
strings.sec.about.lede: Ndingaba 165, umsebenzi wokuqala wawo, njengokulawulwa kwakhe, kunye nezeethics ezidingayo zikunye nendawo yonke.
strings.sec.documents.title: I-Roid yeedokumenti yesiSystem se-165
strings.sec.documents.lede: Iidokumenti ezili-6 ze-lawulo ezisekwe kwindawo yonke yesiSystem se-165.web.id — Master Control, Master Blueprint, I-Architecture yesiSystem, Ukulawula, IConstitution yaseEditorial, kunye nePolicy yesiSource & yokuBonisana — kungabhalisiwe yonke abantu abanokuyibhala.
strings.sec.seo.title: Iiphepha ezithandwayo yi-search engines
strings.sec.seo.lede: Uqalase lwe-1,200+ iiphepha ezikwiqala lemfuzo leTQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah. Iiphepha nganye ibandayo ngokuchanekileko kwedata, imarkup yesemantiki, i-OL ephakathi, kunye neegate ze-verification. Yekwa iminyaka — yalinganisiwe, yaboniswe, yadla.
strings.sec.contribute.title: Yongeza kwirikodi — ngokuhlola, ngokungena
strings.sec.contribute.lede: Abantu bayathumela ukwazi, imaxwebhu, amagama, iinkqubo, amagqirha, isiko lokubhala, kunye neekorekshini. Ukudlala iqhubehe akukupapasha: into yonke ethumelwa ihlolwe ngaphambi kokuza kwindawo.
strings.docs.searchPlaceholder: Vula kwiidokumenti ezili-6... umzekelo. sanad, umsebenzi, iTier A
strings.docs.noResults: Akukho isiqhingi sedokumenti esifana ne"{q}". Zama igama elingeyo — umzekelo. "sanad", "iqinisekiso", "umsebenzi".
strings.docs.verbatimBody: Into oyibhala aha yiyo yindlela yomsebenzi wedokumenti — akukho mafani okanye ukuhlaziywa. Idokumenti nganye ibandayo nge-ID yakuyo eyikanonicali, inkqubo, kunye nenkqubo yayo eyaziwayo; ukuguquka kungenzeka kuphela ngokungena kwe-lawulo, akukho ngokungena ngokungena.
strings.docs.closingNote: Iidokumenti eziyiyo ziyo maxwebhu ekuqaleni kwinkqubo yonke yesitishi: isiseko sendawo, inqanaba le-A-F yeqinisekiso, amazwi e-sanad, ukuya kwinkqubo yase-editorial kwiiiphepha ezininzi zazo ziyazalwa kona. Unokunciphisa okanye ukongeza oku kuqina kwedokumenti? Thumela kwindlela yokudlala iqhubeke — into yonke ethumelwa ihlolwe, akukho into iguquka ngokungena.
strings.lang.title: Ulimi
strings.lang.search: Vula ulimi... (umsebenzi wokuqala, isiNgesi, isiNgesi, code)
strings.lang.hint: Ulimi olunguqala lwe-165 yiNgesi. {curated} iilimi ecurated ngokupheleleyo, {ai} iilimi ehumushwe yi-AI, kunye neeliminini elandelayo alinakukhethwa — isiseko sayo sizohlola iNgesi. Inkqubo yedokumenti yemfuzo ibonakala kululwimi lwakuyo.
